'''X1-09''' was an astromech droid during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], X1-09 asked an Imperial to rendezvous with Moff [[Phennir (Moff)|Phennir]] on the cruiser [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|''White Nova'']].
